carriedForwardNotRetested.name: Explicit position and timeframe evidence for AI reviews
carriedForwardNotRetested.hypothesis: Providing a dated virtual position, cash, cost and timeframe may reduce unsupported EXIT explanations while retaining the deterministic execution envelope. This is not a claim of more trades or higher profit.
carriedForwardNotRetested.performed: Audited review call site at recorded main commit and compared latest copied review with paper ledger.
carriedForwardNotRetested.benefit: Ground commentary in actual inventory and distinguish no-op EXIT from selling an open position.
carriedForwardNotRetested.risk: More tokens, stale position snapshot, prompt drift, and unsupported confidence; context alone cannot create baseline entries.
carriedForwardNotRetested.passCriteria: Isolated candidate only. Freeze context contract and fixtures before test; require accurate inventory/timeframe on all held-out review cases, zero fabricated facts, and unchanged action/risk constraints. Chronological train90/test30 >=3 folds on verified >=180-day data; only already-received data; fills after decision; cost stress as candidate01; at least30 closed OOS trades for profit judgment, positive median incremental netPnL and no DD>8% or exposure>15%. Retain all failed cases. No promotion to primary.
